blocks.label: Moore-Hodgson core
blocks.py:
jobs.sort(key=lambda j: j.deadline)      # deadline asc
dur_heap = []; time = 0; late = 0
for d, dl in jobs:
    time += d
    heapq.heappush(dur_heap, -d)
    if time > dl:
        time += heapq.heappop(dur_heap)   # remove LONGEST duration
        late += 1
